title: Room Reservations Booking Conditions: Cancellation and the Effective Deadline
content:
## Conditions

**1. Right to cancel.** A confirmed Room Reservations reservation may be cancelled at the guest's request at any time before arrival; the cancellation is recorded at the moment the guest's request is taken, and its timing decides every consequence.

**2. Effective deadline days.** The effective deadline days are the plan's resort-brand deadline days when the reservation's hotel brand is Ashbury Resort & Spa or Ashbury Reserve, and the plan's deadline days for most hotels at every other brand; the brand recorded on the reservation decides.

**3. Timeliness.** The cancellation is timely only if the moment the guest's cancellation request is recorded is not later than the effective cancellation deadline counted back from the reservation's arrival date. The effective cancellation deadline is the plan's clock time on the deadline date, hotel local time, on the calendar date obtained by subtracting the effective deadline days, in whole calendar days, from the arrival date currently on the reservation; a cancellation recorded exactly at that minute is timely.

**4. Recording.** A timely cancellation is recorded as before the deadline and any other as after the deadline. On a plan that allows no free cancellation every cancellation is recorded after the deadline whatever the clock shows.

**5. Online travel agency bookings.** Reservations booked through an online travel agency are cancelled only by that agency and not by guest services; the booking channel on the reservation record shows it.

**6. Reservations that cannot be cancelled.** A reservation that is in house, checked out, marked a no-show or relocated cannot be cancelled.

## Plan values used by these conditions

For every rate plan the conditions read four plan figures: whether free cancellation is possible, the deadline days at most hotels, the deadline days at resort brands, and the clock time on the deadline date. Each plan's own figures apply to its reservations.

## Deadline worked through (hypothetical arrival on 20 June, cancellation recorded in hotel local time)

| Plan and brand | Effective deadline days | Effective deadline | Recorded 23:59 on the deadline date | Recorded 00:00 the next day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible Rate, Ashbury Hotel | 1 | 19 June, 23:59 | Before the deadline | After the deadline |
| Flexible Rate, Ashbury Resort & Spa | 3 | 17 June, 23:59 | Before the deadline | After the deadline |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate, Ashbury Reserve | 7 | 13 June, 23:59 | Before the deadline | After the deadline |

**A clock time other than 23:59.** A Corporate Negotiated Rate reservation at an Ashbury Grand has 0 deadline days and an 18:00 clock time, so its deadline is 18:00 on the arrival date itself: recorded at 18:00 on 20 June it is before the deadline; at 18:01 it is after.

**A plan without free cancellation.** An Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate reservation cancelled weeks before arrival is still recorded after the deadline.

**A changed arrival date.** The deadline is counted from the arrival date currently on the reservation; if the arrival date was moved, the moved date is the one counted from.

**Counting.** The effective deadline days are subtracted in whole calendar days from the arrival date; the comparison is then made against the recorded moment of the cancellation, in hotel local time, with the deadline minute itself counting as timely.
